title: Path typesetter
description: Editable type stretches across a cubic curve with two direct manipulation handles.
useCase: Shape a short typographic phrase while preserving its reading order.
interaction: Drag a bend or edit the text.
reducedMotion: All edits are immediate; no autonomous animation.
limitations: A short, single-line phrase up to 18 characters. SVG textPath metrics vary with available Georgia font metrics.
look: Black serif italic phrase riding a thin grey curve on off-white, with two red bezier handles on dashed guides and a ruled text field below.
motion: Dragging either red handle reshapes the cubic curve and the text re-flows along it, stretching letter spacing and glyphs to fill the new length; arrow keys nudge handles.
adapt: The curve is the `d` string built from `points`, and `curveLength` feeds `textLength` so `lengthAdjust` stretches glyphs to fit. Tune `bound` and the `initial` handle positions; replace the default `text` state and the Georgia font settings.
